content: Pitu Angu Balaa

Kasiimpo iaku kurango suara momakaa minaaka i nuncana Baitulla apogau i pitu miaia malaaʼekati sumai, pogauna, "Lingkamo tee ubusakamea pitu angua mangko mokoantoakana pamuruna Aulataʼala sumai i bhawona dunia."

Malaaʼekati mobhaa-bhaana sii abusakamea o antona mangkona sumai i bhawona dunia. Sabutuna adhaangiamo saangu panyaki kabhisu imingkiriaka tee mopekapiina bhari-bharia mia mopakena tandana Binata Masega sumai tee mosombana patuna.
Malaaʼekati i rua miana abusakea o antona mangkona i tawo, sabutuna o tawo amembali raa mokonte mboomo raana mia mate. Bhari-bharia mokoinyawana tee modhadhina i nuncana tawo uka amate.
Malaaʼekati i talu miana abusakea o antona mangkona i nuncana umala tee i manga matana uwe, sabutuna bhari-bharia amembali raa.
Kasiimpo iaku kurango malaaʼekati mokuasaina uwe apogau,

content.text: "Ingkoo uʼadili i nuncana ubhotukiaka kahukumu incia sii,
modhaangiana sii-sii tee modhaangiana i zamani i piamo itu!
Manga incia padhamo apekamate manga mia mosaalihi
sii-sii manga incia padhamo upasumpuakea raa;
dhaanamo manga incia alaenga atarima giu incia sumai."

content: Kasiimpo iaku kurango suara minaaka i tampana tunuana kurubani sumai apogau,

content.text: "E Aulataʼala, e Kawasana Opu Mokokuasana Mpuu,

content: Malaaʼekati i pata miana abusaka antona mangkona i matanaeo, tee Aulataʼala adhawuaka kuasana i matanaeo to apekangauaka maanusia tee kasodhona mboomo waa sumai.

Maanusia apekangauakea tee kasodhona waa momasodhona mpuu sumai, sabutuna manga incia ahina sarona Aulataʼala mokuasaina manga balaa, maka moomini mboo sumai, manga incia amendeu atoba tee amuliangia.
Malaaʼekati i lima miana abusaka antona mangkona i kauncuramakana Binata Masega sumai, sabutuna amalalandamo pamarintana binata sumai, tee manga mia apapaki dhelana roonamo anamisi kapii.
Tee manga mia sumai ahina Aulataʼala i sorogaa roonamo kapii inamisina tee roonamo kabhisuna. Moomini mboo sumai, manga incia amendeu atoba minaaka i pewau madhakina.
Malaaʼekati i nama miana abusaka antona mangkona i umala momaoge, siitumo i Umala Efrat.
Saanampuu amatuumo umala sumai, sabutuna atopasiapumo dhala to manga raja mominaakana i timbu to alaloia.
Kasiimpo iaku kukamata talu mia rohi madhaki mokomodelena mboomo barakaka. Manga incia alimba minaaka i ngangana naga, minaaka i ngangana Binata Masega sumai tee minaaka i ngangana nabii gau-gau.

Talu miaia manga incia satotuuna manga rohina madhaki mopadhaangiana manga tanda inda momentela, tee molingkana mopokawana tee manga raja i saangua dunia, tee manga raja sumai aromusakea to apotimbeaka i eo ogena sumai, siitumo i eo mopadhana ipatotapuakana Aulataʼala Mokokuasana Mpuu.
"Kamatea, Iaku kuumba mboomo samia pande manako! Amasanaamo o mia mosadhaadhaana mokojaga-jaga tee mojaganina pakeana mamudhaakana inda akalealea tee inda amaea i aroana mia bhari."
Kasiimpo manga rohi sumai aromusaka manga raja i tampa isarongiaka Harmagedon i nuncana pogau Ibrani.
Malaaʼekati i pitu miana abusaka antona mangkona i antara, sabutuna atorangomo suara momakaa minaaka i kauncuramakana Aulataʼala i Baitulla i sorogaa mopogauna, "Amondomo!"

Sabutuna o bhibhito apokilatimo, nduuna guntu apogunturi tee aponduurimo, kasiimpo dhaangia tee lendu momakaa mpuu. Kakaana lendu incia sumai indapo dhaangia o sampokanana apepuu minaaka o maanusia adhadhi i bhawona alamu. Tapanamo kakaa o lendu incia sumai.

Kota momaoge sumai apoweta amembali talu weta, tee ahancurumo manga kota i bhari-bharia lipu i dunia. Kasiimpo Aulataʼala atoudhanimo tee kota Babel momaoge sumai. Sabutuna o kota incia sumai apasumpuakea angguru minaaka i tonde mobukeakana tee angguru ipamuruakana mpuu Aulataʼala.
Bhari-bharia pulo amofu, tee manga gunu indamo atokamata rampaakanamo aratamo tee tana.

Kasiimpo waona esi o kaogena mboomo bhatu tee o katamona saasaangu lima pulu kilo amandawu minaaka i laiana akangkanai maanusia. Sumaimo maanusia ahina Aulataʼala rampaakanamo balaana waona esi sumai, roonamo balaa sumai amaoge mpuu.

footnotes.text: Umala Efrat: Umala maoge mosiwuluna alaloi manga tana i zamani sii-sii momembalina lipu Turki, Suria, tee Irak.
